requirements.description: Make the typing import style in asgi.py consistent so the AsyncIterable annotation matches how other typing names are referenced.

label.evidence: httpx/_transports/asgi.py:1 (import typing, the from typing import ... line removed); :8, :13, :62, :65, :75-80 all typing.-qualified; :77 stream: typing.AsyncIterable[bytes]
label.notes: Reviewer's nit asked for bare AsyncIterable via the from-typing import, to match the file's style. The author resolved the inconsistency the opposite way, switching the whole file to import typing and typing.-qualified names (asgi.py:1, 8, 13, 62, 65, 75-80, 77 for stream). The literal suggestion was not applied and the reviewer did not reply, but the file is now uniform.
